subject: POC playbook and kickoff scheduling — Lumina Health

Subject: POC playbook and kickoff scheduling — Lumina Health

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today — appreciate you walking us through the current intake flow and where you need model-driven routing and inference. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we all stay aligned.

Recap (from our notes):
- Primary use case: automated triage + recommended actions for care coordinators (incoming patient messages).
- Success signals you want to measure: intent extraction accuracy, correct recommended action rate, and average inference latency under load.
- Data constraints: PHI-scrubbed test set for the POC, VPC-only access, and audit logs retained for 90 days.

Proposed POC success criteria (first pass):
- Intent extraction F1 >= 0.85 on Lumina test set
- Recommended-action precision >= 0.78 for top-1 suggestion
- 95th percentile inference latency <= 200 ms for 2 concurrent users simulated workload
- No data egress beyond VPC, audit logs accessible to Lumina for the trial period

High-level timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (prep): access, API keys, sample test dataset delivered by Lumina
- Week 1 (kickoff): integrate SDK, baseline smoke tests
- Weeks 2–4 (run): scheduled weekly check-ins, mid-poc quality checkpoint at Week 3
- Week 5 (readout): final evaluation, decision review and next steps

Owners (suggested):
- Redwood: Jordan (sales lead), Marissa (CS, runbook & ops)
- Lumina: Sara (product), Alex Chen (engineering lead), Procurement for SOW/contract

Attachments: lumina-mup-v1-sow.pdf (draft), trial-success-metrics.xlsx (metrics template).

Can you confirm: 1) thumbs up on the success criteria (particularly the latency target), 2) who will own delivering the test dataset, and 3) two 60-minute slots next week for the kickoff (we're proposing Tue 9/21 10am PT or Wed 9/22 2pm PT)?

If that works I'll circulate a short mutual action plan and calendar invites.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122

Subject: Re: POC playbook and kickoff scheduling — Lumina Health

Thanks Jordan — helpful recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Latency: 200 ms p95 is acceptable as a POC target; our production bar will be tighter but this is fine for evaluation.
- Data: we'll provide a PHI-scrubbed dataset (Alex will own delivery). We'll also need to validate that logs are stored in our VPC and that contract language reflects that.
- Additional ask: can you include an evaluation slice for multi-intent messages? We see this in ~18% of traffic and want to ensure the model doesn't collapse multiple intents.

Procurement: looping you in so we can start on the SOW and NDA side — procurement@luminahealth.com will coordinate.

I can do Tue 9/21 10am PT for kickoff. We prefer a morning slot.

Looping in a couple operational notes we typically include in the runbook so Lumina can prep networking and security folks: 

Runbook highlights / pre-kickoff checklist:
- IP allowlist and short-lived API key process (we'll provide CIDR ranges; Lumina to confirm firewall rules)
- Test data ingestion: S3 bucket with presigned URLs or direct SFTP; recommend presigned S3 for larger batches
- Observability: we'll enable per-route token cost and latency traces for the POC; Lumina will have read-only access to logs stored in your VPC endpoint
- Smoke test windows: prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT for the first two iterations; we'll coordinate a 30m window plus a 30m retrospective

Operational availability and escalation:
- Primary on-call during smoke tests: Marissa Cole (redwood on-call)
- Sales escalation: Ben Carter (if procurement/contract blocks progress)

Kickoff slots: confirmed Tue 9/21 10am PT (Jordan already proposed) — I'll use that and send a Teams invite with the integrations checklist attached.

Attachments: runbook-ops-checklist.md (linked in Drive).
